name: ambrygen/quiz-block
title: Quiz Block
description: Interactive hereditary cancer risk checklist with dynamic result messaging and CTA buttons.

heading.default: Could hereditary cancer run in your family?

cardSubtitle.default: Select all that apply to you or your family members

default.text: You or a family member was diagnosed with cancer at a young age (younger than 50 years old)
You or a family member has been diagnosed with more than one cancer
You've been told your cancer type is typically rare - such as ovarian or pancreatic cancer
Multiple people on the same side of your family have had cancer
A family member has already been found to have a cancer gene mutation

noRiskText.default: Based on your current answers, you may not have the typical risk indicators for hereditary cancer. Speak with your healthcare provider if you have any concerns - they may have additional reasons to consider testing.

atRiskTitle.default: Based on your responses, you may want to consider speaking with your healthcare provider about hereditary cancer genetic testing.

atRiskIntro.default: If your responses indicate that you may be at-risk for hereditary cancer, there are important next steps to take.

atRiskText.default: Not everyone who has a risk will necessarily go on to develop disease. Ambry's genetic testing and counseling supports you and your healthcare provider in determining the best plan of action moving forward.*

atRiskFootnote.default: *Your healthcare provider may identify other reasons why it may be beneficial for you to pursue genetic testing.
